title: Phase 51B adds service, infrastructure, planning, workforce, and delivery records
summary: FTFN added six bounded official records across the Southwest chip-corridor and Ontario housing dossiers without promoting any signal: SRP's large-load tariff, a Phoenix-TSMC wastewater agreement, the TSMC-campus PUD, a technician apprenticeship, Toronto committee follow-through, and Toronto's development pipeline.
evidence_note: All six additions are anchored to dated official utility, municipal, economic-development, or planning records. Each signal states the next evidence gate and remains In Review; none enters the Published export.
